title: My Birthday and Holidays
text:
My birthday is in May. It is on the fifteenth of May. We have a party every year at home. My mother makes a big cake.

My friend Anna's birthday is in June, on the first. Her party is in the park. In July and August we go to the sea. These are my favourite months.

questions.text: Why does the narrator probably like July and August?
options: They are on holiday and go to the sea
They are cold and stay at home

questions.text: How does the narrator's family probably celebrate birthdays?
options: They have a party with a big cake

vocabulary.definition: the day of the year when a person was born
a social event where people eat, drink and celebrate
the twelve parts of a year, such as May or June

paragraph_translations: Moje urodziny są w maju. Są piętnastego maja. Co roku mamy przyjęcie w domu. Moja mama robi duży tort.
Urodziny mojej przyjaciółki Anny są w czerwcu, pierwszego dnia. Jej przyjęcie jest w parku. W lipcu i sierpniu jedziemy nad morze. To są moje ulubione miesiące.
